DELETE FROM AGP.BIDR_STG_CLAIM

BEGIN

/*-- FACETS.CMC_PRPR_PROV  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
/*-- FACETS.CMC_PRPR_PROV  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
/*-- FACETS.CMC_PRPR_PROV  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

/* get provider based on a list of claims */
/* also get provider based members pcp where members are on a list of claims */
INSERT INTO AGP.BIDR_XFER_LINE (TABLE_NAME, ORDINAL, LINE_DATA) SELECT 'FACETS.CMC_PRPR_PROV', 0, 'PRPR_ID#|#PRPR_MCTR_TYPE#|#PRCF_MCTR_SPEC#|#PRPR_NAME#|#PRPR_NPI#|#PRCP_ID#|#PRAD_ID#|#PRAD_TYPE_CHECK#|#PRAD_TYPE_PRIM#|#MCTN_ID#|#PRPR_MCTR_LANG#|#PRPR_TERM_DT' FROM DUAL;
INSERT INTO AGP.BIDR_XFER_LINE (TABLE_NAME, ORDINAL, LINE_DATA)
SELECT /*+ parallel(P,4) parallel(C,4) parallel(C2,4)*/
  'FACETS.CMC_PRPR_PROV',
  1,
  P.PRPR_ID || '#|#' ||
  P.PRPR_MCTR_TYPE || '#|#' ||
  P.PRCF_MCTR_SPEC || '#|#' ||
  P.PRPR_NAME || '#|#' ||
  P.PRPR_NPI || '#|#' ||
  P.PRCP_ID || '#|#' ||
  P.PRAD_ID || '#|#' ||
  P.PRAD_TYPE_CHECK || '#|#' ||
  P.PRAD_TYPE_PRIM || '#|#' ||
  P.MCTN_ID || '#|#' ||
  P.PRPR_MCTR_LANG || '#|#' ||
  TO_CHAR(P.PRPR_TERM_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD')  
FROM FACETS.CMC_PRPR_PROV P
INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_CLCL_CLAIM C ON C.PRPR_ID = P.PRPR_ID
INNER JOIN AGP.BIDR_STG_CLAIM C2 ON C2.CLCL_ID = C.CLCL_ID
UNION
SELECT /*+ parallel(P,4) parallel(R,4) parallel(C,4) parallel(C2,4)*/
  'FACETS.CMC_PRPR_PROV',
  1,
  P.PRPR_ID || '#|#' ||
  P.PRPR_MCTR_TYPE || '#|#' ||
  P.PRCF_MCTR_SPEC || '#|#' ||
  P.PRPR_NAME || '#|#' ||
  P.PRPR_NPI || '#|#' ||
  P.PRCP_ID || '#|#' ||
  P.PRAD_ID || '#|#' ||
  P.PRAD_TYPE_CHECK || '#|#' ||
  P.PRAD_TYPE_PRIM || '#|#' ||
  P.MCTN_ID || '#|#' ||
  P.PRPR_MCTR_LANG || '#|#' ||
  TO_CHAR(P.PRPR_TERM_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
FROM FACETS.CMC_PRPR_PROV P
INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPR_PRIM_PROV R ON R.PRPR_ID = P.PRPR_ID
INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_CLCL_CLAIM C ON C.MEME_CK = R.MEME_CK
INNER JOIN AGP.BIDR_STG_CLAIM C2 ON C2.CLCL_ID = C.CLCL_ID;
COMMIT;


/*-- FACETS.CMC_PRAD_ADDRESS  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
/*-- FACETS.CMC_PRAD_ADDRESS  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
/*-- FACETS.CMC_PRAD_ADDRESS  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

/* get provider business/remid address based on a list of claims */
/* also get provider business/remid address based members pcp where members are on a list of claims */
INSERT INTO AGP.BIDR_XFER_LINE (TABLE_NAME, ORDINAL, LINE_DATA) SELECT 'FACETS.CMC_PRAD_ADDRESS', 0, 'PRAD_ID#|#PRAD_TYPE#|#PRAD_EFF_DT#|#PRAD_TERM_DT#|#PRAD_ADDR1#|#PRAD_ADDR2#|#PRAD_ADDR3#|#PRAD_CITY#|#PRAD_STATE#|#PRAD_ZIP#|#PRAD_COUNTY#|#PRAD_CTRY_CD#|#PRAD_PHONE#|#PRAD_PHONE_EXT#|#PRAD_FAX#|#PRAD_FAX_EXT#|#PRAD_EMAIL' FROM DUAL;
INSERT INTO AGP.BIDR_XFER_LINE (TABLE_NAME, ORDINAL, LINE_DATA)
SELECT /*+ parallel(P,4) parallel(A,4) parallel(C,4) parallel(C2,4)*/
	'FACETS.CMC_PRAD_ADDRESS',
  1,
	A.PRAD_ID || '#|#' ||
	A.PRAD_TYPE || '#|#' ||
	TO_CHAR(A.PRAD_EFF_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || '#|#' ||
  TO_CHAR(A.PRAD_TERM_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || '#|#' ||
	A.PRAD_ADDR1 || '#|#' ||
	A.PRAD_ADDR2 || '#|#' ||
	A.PRAD_ADDR3 || '#|#' ||
	A.PRAD_CITY || '#|#' ||
	A.PRAD_STATE || '#|#' ||
	A.PRAD_ZIP || '#|#' ||
	A.PRAD_COUNTY || '#|#' ||
	A.PRAD_CTRY_CD || '#|#' ||
	A.PRAD_PHONE || '#|#' ||
	A.PRAD_PHONE_EXT || '#|#' ||
	A.PRAD_FAX || '#|#' ||
	A.PRAD_FAX_EXT || '#|#' ||
	A.PRAD_EMAIL
FROM FACETS.CMC_PRPR_PROV P
INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_PRAD_ADDRESS A ON A.PRAD_ID = P.PRAD_ID
	AND A.PRAD_TYPE = P.PRAD_TYPE_PRIM
INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_CLCL_CLAIM C ON C.PRPR_ID = P.PRPR_ID
INNER JOIN AGP.BIDR_STG_CLAIM C2 ON C2.CLCL_ID = C.CLCL_ID
UNION	
SELECT /*+ parallel(P,4) parallel(A,4) parallel(C,4) parallel(C2,4)*/
	'FACETS.CMC_PRAD_ADDRESS',
  1,
	A.PRAD_ID || '#|#' ||
	A.PRAD_TYPE || '#|#' ||
	TO_CHAR(A.PRAD_EFF_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || '#|#' ||
  TO_CHAR(A.PRAD_TERM_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || '#|#' ||
	A.PRAD_ADDR1 || '#|#' ||
	A.PRAD_ADDR2 || '#|#' ||
	A.PRAD_ADDR3 || '#|#' ||
	A.PRAD_CITY || '#|#' ||
	A.PRAD_STATE || '#|#' ||
	A.PRAD_ZIP || '#|#' ||
	A.PRAD_COUNTY || '#|#' ||
	A.PRAD_CTRY_CD || '#|#' ||
	A.PRAD_PHONE || '#|#' ||
	A.PRAD_PHONE_EXT || '#|#' ||
	A.PRAD_FAX || '#|#' ||
	A.PRAD_FAX_EXT || '#|#' ||
	A.PRAD_EMAIL
FROM FACETS.CMC_PRPR_PROV P
INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_PRAD_ADDRESS A ON A.PRAD_ID = P.PRAD_ID
	AND A.PRAD_TYPE = P.PRAD_TYPE_CHECK
INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_CLCL_CLAIM C ON C.PRPR_ID = P.PRPR_ID
INNER JOIN AGP.BIDR_STG_CLAIM C2 ON C2.CLCL_ID = C.CLCL_ID
UNION
SELECT /*+ parallel(P,4) parallel(R,4) parallel(A,4) parallel(C,4) parallel(C2,4)*/
	'FACETS.CMC_PRAD_ADDRESS',
  1,
	A.PRAD_ID || '#|#' ||
	A.PRAD_TYPE || '#|#' ||
	TO_CHAR(A.PRAD_EFF_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || '#|#' ||
  TO_CHAR(A.PRAD_TERM_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || '#|#' ||
	A.PRAD_ADDR1 || '#|#' ||
	A.PRAD_ADDR2 || '#|#' ||
	A.PRAD_ADDR3 || '#|#' ||
	A.PRAD_CITY || '#|#' ||
	A.PRAD_STATE || '#|#' ||
	A.PRAD_ZIP || '#|#' ||
	A.PRAD_COUNTY || '#|#' ||
	A.PRAD_CTRY_CD || '#|#' ||
	A.PRAD_PHONE || '#|#' ||
	A.PRAD_PHONE_EXT || '#|#' ||
	A.PRAD_FAX || '#|#' ||
	A.PRAD_FAX_EXT || '#|#' ||
	A.PRAD_EMAIL
FROM FACETS.CMC_PRPR_PROV P
INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_PRAD_ADDRESS A ON A.PRAD_ID = P.PRAD_ID
	AND A.PRAD_TYPE = P.PRAD_TYPE_PRIM
INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPR_PRIM_PROV R ON R.PRPR_ID = P.PRPR_ID
INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_CLCL_CLAIM C ON C.MEME_CK = R.MEME_CK
INNER JOIN AGP.BIDR_STG_CLAIM C2 ON C2.CLCL_ID = C.CLCL_ID
UNION	
SELECT /*+ parallel(P,4) parallel(R,4) parallel(A,4) parallel(C,4) parallel(C2,4)*/
	'FACETS.CMC_PRAD_ADDRESS',
  1,
	A.PRAD_ID || '#|#' ||
	A.PRAD_TYPE || '#|#' ||
	TO_CHAR(A.PRAD_EFF_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || '#|#' ||
  TO_CHAR(A.PRAD_TERM_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || '#|#' ||
	A.PRAD_ADDR1 || '#|#' ||
	A.PRAD_ADDR2 || '#|#' ||
	A.PRAD_ADDR3 || '#|#' ||
	A.PRAD_CITY || '#|#' ||
	A.PRAD_STATE || '#|#' ||
	A.PRAD_ZIP || '#|#' ||
	A.PRAD_COUNTY || '#|#' ||
	A.PRAD_CTRY_CD || '#|#' ||
	A.PRAD_PHONE || '#|#' ||
	A.PRAD_PHONE_EXT || '#|#' ||
	A.PRAD_FAX || '#|#' ||
	A.PRAD_FAX_EXT || '#|#' ||
	A.PRAD_EMAIL
FROM FACETS.CMC_PRPR_PROV P
INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_PRAD_ADDRESS A ON A.PRAD_ID = P.PRAD_ID
	AND A.PRAD_TYPE = P.PRAD_TYPE_CHECK
INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPR_PRIM_PROV R ON R.PRPR_ID = P.PRPR_ID
INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_CLCL_CLAIM C ON C.MEME_CK = R.MEME_CK
INNER JOIN AGP.BIDR_STG_CLAIM C2 ON C2.CLCL_ID = C.CLCL_ID;
COMMIT;


/*-- FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
/*-- FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
/*-- FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

/* get members based on a list of claims */
INSERT INTO AGP.BIDR_XFER_LINE (TABLE_NAME, ORDINAL, LINE_DATA) SELECT 'FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER',0,'MEME_CK#|#SBSB_CK#|#GRGR_CK#|#MEME_REL#|#MEME_LAST_NAME#|#MEME_FIRST_NAME#|#MEME_SSN#|#MEME_SEX#|#MEME_BIRTH_DT#|#MEME_MCTR_LANG#|#MEME_HICN#|#MEME_MEDCD_NO' FROM DUAL;
INSERT INTO AGP.BIDR_XFER_LINE (TABLE_NAME, ORDINAL, LINE_DATA)
SELECT /*+ parallel(M,4) parallel(C,4) parallel(C2,4)*/
	'FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER',
	1,
	M.MEME_CK || '#|#' || 
	M.SBSB_CK || '#|#' ||
	M.GRGR_CK || '#|#' || 
	M.MEME_REL || '#|#' || 
	M.MEME_LAST_NAME || '#|#' || 
	M.MEME_FIRST_NAME || '#|#' || 
	M.MEME_SSN || '#|#' || 
	M.MEME_SEX || '#|#' || 
	TO_CHAR(M.MEME_BIRTH_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || '#|#' ||
	M.MEME_MCTR_LANG || '#|#' || 
	M.MEME_HICN || '#|#' || 
	M.MEME_MEDCD_NO
FROM FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER M
INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_CLCL_CLAIM C ON C.MEME_CK = M.MEME_CK
INNER JOIN AGP.BIDR_STG_CLAIM C2 ON C2.CLCL_ID = C.CLCL_ID;
COMMIT;


/*-- FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
/*-- FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
/*-- FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

/* get subscribers based on a list of claims */
INSERT INTO AGP.BIDR_XFER_LINE (TABLE_NAME, ORDINAL, LINE_DATA) SELECT 'FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC',0,'SBSB_CK#|#SBSB_ID#|#SBAD_TYPE_HOME#|#SBAD_TYPE_MAIL#|#SBAD_TYPE_WORK' FROM DUAL;
INSERT INTO AGP.BIDR_XFER_LINE (TABLE_NAME, ORDINAL, LINE_DATA)
SELECT /*+ parallel(S,4) parallel(M,4) parallel(C,4) parallel(C2,4)*/
	'FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC',
	1,
	S.SBSB_CK || '#|#' ||
	S.SBSB_ID || '#|#' ||
	S.SBAD_TYPE_HOME || '#|#' || 
	S.SBAD_TYPE_MAIL || '#|#' || 
	S.SBAD_TYPE_WORK
FROM FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC S
INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER M ON M.SBSB_CK = S.SBSB_CK
INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_CLCL_CLAIM C ON C.MEME_CK = M.MEME_CK
INNER JOIN AGP.BIDR_STG_CLAIM C2 ON C2.CLCL_ID = C.CLCL_ID;
COMMIT;


/*-- FACETS.CMC_SBAD_ADDR  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
/*-- FACETS.CMC_SBAD_ADDR  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
/*-- FACETS.CMC_SBAD_ADDR  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

/* get member address based on a list of claims */
INSERT INTO AGP.BIDR_XFER_LINE (TABLE_NAME, ORDINAL, LINE_DATA) SELECT 'FACETS.CMC_SBAD_ADDR',0,'SBSB_CK#|#SBAD_TYPE#|#GRGR_CK#|#SBAD_ADDR1#|#SBAD_ADDR2#|#SBAD_ADDR3#|#SBAD_CITY#|#SBAD_STATE#|#SBAD_ZIP#|#SBAD_COUNTY#|#SBAD_CTRY_CD#|#SBAD_PHONE#|#SBAD_PHONE_EXT#|#SBAD_FAX#|#SBAD_FAX_EXT#|#SBAD_EMAIL' FROM DUAL;
INSERT INTO AGP.BIDR_XFER_LINE (TABLE_NAME, ORDINAL, LINE_DATA)
SELECT /*+ parallel(A,4) parallel(S,4) parallel(M,4) parallel(C,4) parallel(C2,4)*/
	'FACETS.CMC_SBAD_ADDR',
	1,
	A.SBSB_CK || '#|#' || 
	A.SBAD_TYPE || '#|#' || 
	A.GRGR_CK || '#|#' || 
	A.SBAD_ADDR1 || '#|#' || 
	A.SBAD_ADDR2 || '#|#' || 
	A.SBAD_ADDR3 || '#|#' || 
	A.SBAD_CITY || '#|#' || 	
	A.SBAD_STATE || '#|#' || 
	A.SBAD_ZIP || '#|#' || 
	A.SBAD_COUNTY || '#|#' || 
	A.SBAD_CTRY_CD || '#|#' || 
	A.SBAD_PHONE || '#|#' || 
	A.SBAD_PHONE_EXT || '#|#' || 
	A.SBAD_FAX || '#|#' || 
	A.SBAD_FAX_EXT || '#|#' || 
	A.SBAD_EMAIL
FROM FACETS.CMC_SBAD_ADDR A
INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC S ON S.SBSB_CK = A.SBSB_CK
	AND (S.SBAD_TYPE_HOME = A.SBAD_TYPE
		OR S.SBAD_TYPE_MAIL = A.SBAD_TYPE
		OR S.SBAD_TYPE_WORK = A.SBAD_TYPE)
INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER M ON M.SBSB_CK = S.SBSB_CK
INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_CLCL_CLAIM C ON C.MEME_CK = M.MEME_CK
INNER JOIN AGP.BIDR_STG_CLAIM C2 ON C2.CLCL_ID = C.CLCL_ID;
COMMIT;



/*-- FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
/*-- FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
/*-- FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

/* get member eligibility based on a list of claims */
INSERT INTO AGP.BIDR_XFER_LINE (TABLE_NAME, ORDINAL, LINE_DATA) SELECT 'FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG',0,'MEME_CK#|#CSPD_CAT#|#MEPE_EFF_DT#|#MEPE_TERM_DT#|#CSCS_ID#|#GRGR_CK#|#SGSG_CK#|#CSPI_ID#|#PDPD_ID#|#MEPE_ELIG_IND' FROM DUAL;
INSERT INTO AGP.BIDR_XFER_LINE (TABLE_NAME, ORDINAL, LINE_DATA)
SELECT /*+ parallel(E,4) parallel(C,4) parallel(C2,4)*/
	'FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG',
	1,
	E.MEME_CK || '#|#' || 
	E.CSPD_CAT || '#|#' || 
  TO_CHAR(E.MEPE_EFF_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || '#|#' ||
  TO_CHAR(E.MEPE_TERM_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || '#|#' ||
	E.CSCS_ID || '#|#' || 
	E.GRGR_CK || '#|#' || 
	E.SGSG_CK || '#|#' || 
	E.CSPI_ID || '#|#' || 
	E.PDPD_ID || '#|#' || 
	E.MEPE_ELIG_IND
FROM FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG E
INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_CLCL_CLAIM C ON C.MEME_CK = E.MEME_CK
INNER JOIN AGP.BIDR_STG_CLAIM C2 ON C2.CLCL_ID = C.CLCL_ID;
COMMIT;




/*-- FACETS.CMC_MEPR_PRIM_PROV  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
/*-- FACETS.CMC_MEPR_PRIM_PROV  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
/*-- FACETS.CMC_MEPR_PRIM_PROV  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

/* get member pcp based on a list of claims */
INSERT INTO AGP.BIDR_XFER_LINE (TABLE_NAME, ORDINAL, LINE_DATA) SELECT 'FACETS.CMC_MEPR_PRIM_PROV',0,'MEME_CK#|#MEPR_PCP_TYPE#|#MEPR_EFF_DT#|#MEPR_TERM_DT#|#GRGR_CK#|#PRPR_ID' FROM DUAL;
INSERT INTO AGP.BIDR_XFER_LINE (TABLE_NAME, ORDINAL, LINE_DATA)
SELECT /*+ parallel(P,4) parallel(C,4) parallel(C2,4)*/
	'FACETS.CMC_MEPR_PRIM_PROV',
	1,
	P.MEME_CK || '#|#' || 
	P.MEPR_PCP_TYPE || '#|#' || 
  TO_CHAR(P.MEPR_EFF_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || '#|#' ||
  TO_CHAR(P.MEPR_TERM_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || '#|#' ||
	P.GRGR_CK || '#|#' || 
	P.PRPR_ID
FROM FACETS.CMC_MEPR_PRIM_PROV P
INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_CLCL_CLAIM C ON C.MEME_CK = P.MEME_CK
INNER JOIN AGP.BIDR_STG_CLAIM C2 ON C2.CLCL_ID = C.CLCL_ID;
COMMIT;

END;
